children: Enterprise Products Operating completed a $1.5 billion public offering of senior notes, comprising $750 million of 5.20% notes due 2032 and $750 million of 5.65% notes due 2037, guaranteed by Enterprise Products Partners. Proceeds are expected to support general corporate purposes, including growth investments and acquisitions, and debt repayment. The offering was arranged under an underwriting agreement entered into on November 5, 2026.
Agreement 1: Enterprise Products Completes $1.5 Billion Senior Notes Offering Due 2032 and 2037
: Senior notes issuance under supplemental indenture
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee, and noteholders
: Fund general corporate purposes and repay debt
Agreement 2: Enterprise Products Arranges Underwriting for $1.5 Billion Senior Notes Offering
: Underwriting agreement for a public senior notes offering
: MUFG Securities Americas, Citigroup Global Markets, PNC Capital Markets, SG Americas Securities and U.S. Bancorp Investments, as representatives of the underwriters
: Underwrite and complete the senior notes offering
